budget_rule: not applied: the lists of AUDIT 4.1 run in full on the machine of record (PLAN 13, A6 revised point 6; PLAN 16.5 recommendation R1). No run was dropped.

warmstart_check.rule: PLAN 17.11 (fixed before any network result of the job was read): a network run is re-run if and only if (a) one of its varying target columns lies below the floor, so that the fix changes its warm start, or (b) its recorded kl_map at initialisation exceeds 1e-4 nat. Both are properties of the initialisation, not of the outcome. A re-run gets a new run name; the original is kept and labelled as superseded.
